note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative, jurisdiction unspecified. The two scenes differ only in the new case's value of one supplied feature; relevance and rule text are supplied by the author. No winner, score or legal consequence is shown.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional loan of a ladder on two identical tracing boards. Scene A: the new case also agreed a return date — its print lands on the earlier case's print and they coincide ('='). Scene B: no return date was agreed — its print lands beside it ('≠'). Everything else is identical.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a lent bicycle; the changed feature is the length of the loan (same two days in scene A; one month, with a calendar pictogram, in scene B), another rule text and a shared-facts footnote.

rules.name: Rule Q (illustrative)
rules.text: “Where an item is lent for a stated time, …”

issues: Does the new loan share the feature Rule Q names?
assumptions: Durations as stated by each borrower

scenarioA.label: Relevant similarity
scenarioA.caption: New loan: kept for two days

scenarioB.label: Relevant difference
scenarioB.caption: New loan: kept for one month

comparisonLabels.guide: Only the length of the loan changes
comparisonLabels.neutral: Same bicycle, same friend, same message in both scenes · no outcome is shown
